# cloudflare_zero_trust_casb_integration (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_casb_integration" "example_zero_trust_casb_integration" {
  account_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  id = "id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)

### Optional

Exactly one of `id` or `filter` must be configured.

- `filter` (Attributes) Lookup filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `id` (String) Integration ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `application` (Map of String)
- `auth_method` (Map of String) The integration's authentication method.
- `authorization_link` (Attributes) Authorization link for the integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization_link))
- `created` (String) When the integration was created.
- `credentials_expiry` (String) Credentials expiry time.
- `dlp_profiles` (List of String) DLP Profiles enabled for the integration.
- `health_details` (List of Map of String) Health details with remediation hints.
- `is_paused` (Boolean) Whether the user paused the integration.
- `last_hydrated` (String) Last time the integration was hydrated.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `status` (String) Integration status.
- `updated` (String) When the integration was last updated.
- `use_cases` (List of Map of String) Use cases enabled for the integration.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `application` (String) Filter by application/vendor (e.g., GOOGLE_WORKSPACE, MICROSOFT_INTERNAL).
- `direction` (String) Direction to order results.
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `dlp_enabled` (Boolean) Filter by DLP enabled status (true/false).
- `order` (String) Field to order results by.
Available values: "application", "created", "name", "status".
- `page` (Number) Page number within the paginated result set.
- `page_size` (Number) Number of results per page.
- `search` (String) Search integrations by name or application.
- `status` (String) Filter by integration status.
Available values: "Healthy", "Initializing", "Offline", "Unhealthy".
- `use_cases` (String) Filter by one enabled use case (for example, casb or ces).
